title: HUF-GOV current doctrine index
author: Peter Higgins (human authorship for claims); AI-assisted per HUF-STD-001 (Claude Fable 5)
supersedes: _legacy_2026-03/ (LOOP-001, SAFE-001, KILL-001, MONITOR-001 + GOV-003/HAGF-001/TRANS-001/ontological-foundation + evidence/science/tools) — preserved verbatim, not deleted
determinism: binding by doctrine and practice: hash-chained, reproducible, no statistics in the science path

doctrines.name: Open-Loop Doctrine (Skydiver Principle)
doctrines.one_line: The instrument reads, the expert decides, the loop stays open.
doctrines.cntt_binding: engine emits diagnostics + SS-CCC-LLL codes + hash receipt; never an action or recommendation
doctrines.nasa: human decision authority; no autonomous actuation without operator volition

doctrines.name: Safe Operations Doctrine
doctrines.one_line: Perceive before acting; sometimes do nothing; always have a hold-and-report safe state.
doctrines.cntt_binding: DX-NUL-DIS null flag = hold-and-report in code; a null is a finding not a failure
doctrines.nasa: safe-state / abort-to-known-safe; fault tolerance; no-op is a valid command

doctrines.name: Kill-Test Doctrine (negative control)
doctrines.one_line: If it cannot be broken it is not science; map the cliff edge with the rigor of the successes.
doctrines.cntt_binding: self-test + frozen-oracle parity + disjoint-atlas L3-DSJ-ERR + E-21 carrier guard = fail loudly at the boundary
doctrines.nasa: verification & validation; off-nominal testing; documented operating limits

doctrines.name: Composition Monitoring (MC-4)
doctrines.one_line: Magnitude/Identity/Trend/Composition; Composition is the 4th category — recognition, not invention.
doctrines.cntt_binding: deterministic composition read (K_eff, helmsman, regime, deceptive-drift) with content hash
doctrines.nasa: observability; the monitoring taxonomy that precedes any control decision

scope_line: The mathematics is standard CoDa-compatible geometry; what is new is the deterministic monitoring instrument built around it. Hs is an extension to standard CoDa, using standard CoDa tools (CLR, ILR, Aitchison metric) in machine applications, with determinism strictly adhered to.
